final: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / replacement_cost) AS avg_ratio, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film GROUP BY rating), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_value FROM rating_stats) SELECT rs.rating, rs.avg_ratio, rs.film_count, rs.avg_ratio - oa.overall_value AS diff_from_overall FROM rating_stats rs CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa ORDER BY rs.rating
